mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 320 is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as high inflation erodes corporate margins and increases risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 320, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 3.5% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 320, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days are negative, as high rates and high inflation compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: The interaction effect fails: when FEDFUNDS>3.5 and CPIAUCSL>320, SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (defined by GDPC1 yoy growth > 2.5%), a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 3.5% is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the economy is vulnerable to monetary tightening.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 yoy growth > 2.5%, FEDFUNDS > 3.5% is associated with positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 4.5% is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as high unemployment signals potential monetary easing and reduced recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The industrial production index (INDPRO) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as higher industrial output signals robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: Rank IC between INDPRO and 60d S&P 500 returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST value above 1300 is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as strong housing starts indicate a healthy economy and rising consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1300, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300 and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 700000, S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days are positive, as strong consumer spending and housing activity signal economic resilience.
failure_condition: The interaction effect fails: when HOUST>1300 and RSAFS>700000, SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
